name: scenario-b-relative-date-year-hallucination
description: Reproduce the year-hallucination bug from real conversation 5d72fb92 where the assistant said 'July 11' with the wrong year. The caller gives a specific date that is in the future relative to today (Dec 4 2026, today is mid-Nov). The assistant must NOT state a wrong year and must call check_availability with the caller's date.
replay_user_turns: i'd like to book a routine cleaning for december 4 2026 in the morning
test_turn: yes 10am sounds good if that's available

tool_calls.name: check_availability
tool_calls.description: assistant must call check_availability for the caller's date

tool_calls.name: book_appointment
tool_calls.description: must not commit a booking before the caller confirms name + slot

assertions.llm_judge_rubric: The response must NOT mention a wrong year (e.g. 2024, 2025, 2027, 2030). It may silently omit the year — that's acceptable. If a year is mentioned, it must be 2026. If a date is mentioned, it must be December 4 (2026-12-04) — not a different date. The response must be short (no more than 3 sentences, no bullet points). The response must NOT claim the booking date is in the past (December 4 2026 is in the future).
